_note: Design-adherence selectors migrated from the repository-root _adherence.oxlintrc.json. oxlint 1.x does not implement `no-restricted-syntax`, so these are not executed by oxlint. The raw-hex and raw-px checks are enforced by scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs; the per-component prop allow-lists are now enforced by TypeScript instead, since every component has real prop types after the .jsx -> .tsx migration.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:Nunito Sans|IBM Plex Sans Arabic|IBM Plex Mono))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: Nunito Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, IBM Plex Mono.
